verdict.rationale: Vast Serverless lets you run GPU workloads without managing GPUs and bills for execution rather than rental time. It offers benchmark-driven automatic scaling that recruits GPUs for the workload, and you manage serverless endpoints through the Python SDK and CLI. This covers the core of deploying to autoscaling serverless workers instead of always-on instances. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scale-to-zero behavior and cold-start handling, detailed deployment workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
